snippet.title: Broomstick Exorcist - Official Developer Gameplay Trailer | The MIX Fall Game Showcase 2025
snippet.description: Join developer Digital Happiness for a closer look at gameplay from Broomstick Exorcist in this trailer for the upcoming supernatural Beat 'em up game set in a hand-drawn 2.5D manga-esque monochromatic world. In Broomstick Exorcist, play as Vikka, an insomniac street sweeper who hunts demons at night with her trusty broomstick and supernatural skills. Broomstick Exorcist will be available on PC. A demo will be available on Steam in October 2025.
